'''Green''' can refer to the following:

* [[Green]] -  a common name for the communal gathering area present in many villages.

==People and groups==
* [[Captain of the Green]] - a high naval rank in the [[Ever Victorious Army]] of the [[Seanchan]].
* [[Green Ajah]] - [[Aes Sedai]] that hold themselves ready for [[Tarmon Gai'don]].
* [[Green Salts]] - a [[sept]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].
* [[Someshta]] - known as the Green Man, the last of the [[Nym]].

==''[[Ter'angreal]]''==
* [[Green stone disc]] - a ''ter'angreal'' created by [[Elayne Trakand]].
* [[Ring with green stone]] - a ''ter'angreal'' that can be used to detect ''[[saidin]]'' and ''[[saidar]]''.

==Others==
* [[Greenwort]] - an [[herb]] used in inducing sleep and relieving stomach cramps.
